title: Listen. Follow. Obey. Siren.
description:
Hello, Sweeteas!
It’s a long, technically complicated file, but with a simple overarching theme: ultimate, uncompromising submission to me, to the Siren, and to dominant, confident women. There are no safeties here, like in most of my files, so if you haven’t yet gotten your agency all figured out, I suggest getting that under control first.
There are suggestions here to speak out loud, but if you cannot do so, sub-vocalization is more than fine enough.
The main suggestion here, once you get past the mermaid fantasy aspect, is that youmustobey me and any confident, dominant woman who wishes to control you. This involves hypnotic conditioning and trance. It includes everything, so if you don’t want to be a weak, obedient, receptive little thing when confronted with feminine prowess, don’t listen. If you do….
This isn’t a sequel to any of my files, but its essence isn’t much different than myListen to Lilithfile and it shares many similarities toVenomous Persuasions.There is no need to listen to either to fully enjoy this one, but as with most of my files, the compounding suggestions speed up and strengthen the effects.
If you’d like, you can read the script for full spoilers.
Have fun!
For the full, unabridged description, please follow the Reddit link below. For a lower quality audio stream, use Soundgasm. For videos, we’ve got…Pornhub.
Click on the three “dots” to the right of the player and choosedownloadfrom the menu.If there is no “download” option, try a different browser, like Chrome or Firefox.
